spec_match.rationale: Probes the attribute, addWords/removeWords, absence of any reader, and treats the attribute (not the interface) as the feature test, per the PR.

interactive.rationale: The probe runs on load and renders a live table, but there is nothing for the visitor to do — no "try addWords" action on this page.

edge_cases.rationale: Absent-vs-present branches both verified (unflagged: absent; flagged: present).

references.rationale: Cites chromestatus.com/feature/<id> in the see-also block plus the spec/explainer.

conformance.rationale: Unflagged: 2 PASS / 5 FAIL (feature is "experimental" in runtime_enabled_features.json5); with --enable-blink-features=SpellCheckCustomDictionaryAPI: 7/7 PASS, including the write-only and [SameObject] contracts.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass): unflagged "Not here" and flagged "Present" verdicts both observed; console clean; not a chrome-devtools-mcp/Canary pass, and no accessibility-tree inspection.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry is loaded and the page records named assertions for its main measurement; no unexpected errors seen.

design_system.rationale: Inline styles use the design-system variables; button overrides keep text/background pairs readable; not a static card.

accessibility.rationale: Native, labelled controls (no unnamed controls found), visible focus on a Tab walk, and results surfaced as text in status/output regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360×740 documentElement.scrollWidth === innerWidth (wide content scrolls inside its own container) and desktop 1280×800 lays out cleanly.

openQuestions.title: Add the SpellCheckCustomDictionaryAPI flag banner
openQuestions.detail: The pages carry no flag instructions. In runtime_enabled_features.json5 the feature is SpellCheckCustomDictionaryAPI with status "experimental"; relaunching with --enable-blink-features=SpellCheckCustomDictionaryAPI made document.spellCheckCustomDictionary appear (addWords/removeWords) and the suite go 7/7. Give the exact chrome://flags/#enable-experimental-web-platform-features and --enable-blink-features steps (rule 10).

openQuestions.title: Add a "call it" control and a [SameObject] check
openQuestions.detail: Add a button that calls addWords(["…"]) then removeWords on a sample word and reports whether it threw, and show document.spellCheckCustomDictionary === document.spellCheckCustomDictionary — both contracts the suite asserts but the page does not exercise.
